mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, we are looking at clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a waxing gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
City buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday with adjusted trash pickup, and the Public Works department is planning an expansion due to our city's growth.
We have live music at Bailey's Run today, and tomorrow brings more live music at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's.
On November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was arrested for O W I after being found unresponsive in her vehicle.
Stop by for a scoop of today's flavor, Really Reese's, as the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
